designs.title: How to Go to Bed
designs.why: Instantly relatable dog-owner joke: the four repeated 'Turn around.' steps do the work and the 'Sigh.' ending lands. Brush line art is warm, consistent and clean in one ink, works on both black and white, and the title reads from across a room. Holding it back from a $50 price: step 4 is an anatomical tangle (head seems to come out of the back, legs are unclear), so the circling sequence stumbles exactly where it should build. Step 1's front legs are also knotted, and the small captions disappear on the tee at distance.
designs.fix: Redraw step 4 (and tidy step 5) so the dog is clearly a tighter nose-to-tail circle than step 3, making the four turn-around poses read as one obvious spiral into the curl-up.
